report.title: Using dollar sign causes improper formatting
report.body: ### Check before submitting - [x] I searched existing issues and did not find a duplicate ### Describe the bug See image. Not sure which is causing this. The problematic text should read: `with the local markets... $22 for the smallest bit of rice and fried chicken.` ### Steps to reproduce Try and write any kind of amount of money or use ellipsis. ### Memos version 0.30.0 ### Additional context _No response_

preconditions: the Memos editor is available to the signed-in user
the reporter says the problem happens when writing a money amount with a dollar sign or when using an ellipsis
steps: Click the memo editor input on the home page
Type "with the local markets... $22 for the smallest bit of rice and fried chicken."
Click the Save button to create the memo
Look at the rendered memo in the memo list
plan.expected: the saved memo shows the text exactly as typed: "with the local markets... $22 for the smallest bit of rice and fried chicken.", with the "$22" and the ellipsis visible and no broken or math-style formatting
plan.reported_actual: the memo text is displayed with improper formatting (shown in a screenshot, not described in text) when it contains a dollar amount or an ellipsis
missing: What exactly does the improper formatting look like (the screenshot is not available)?
Is the cause the dollar sign, the ellipsis, or both together?
Does the problem occur with only one dollar amount in the text, or only when a second '$' appears elsewhere in the memo (for example, as an inline math delimiter)?
Is there any text before or after the quoted line in the original memo?
assumed: the problem is visible in the rendered memo after saving, not in the editor while typing
assumed: the quoted sentence from the report is enough to trigger the bug, since the reporter gave it as the problematic text
plan.summary: Memo text containing a dollar amount and ellipsis renders with improper formatting
